description: This NRA page gives the current operating status of Japan's commercial nuclear power stations, with a last update date of 16 September 2026. The overview counts 8 stations and 11 units in operation, 12 stations and 22 units shut down, 3 stations and 3 units under construction (Ohma, Higashidori of Tokyo Electric and Shimane 3), 12 stations and 20 units in decommissioning, including the research and development reactors Monju and Fugen, and no stations abolished. Below the overview each station is listed by operator, for example Hokkaido Electric Power's Tomari, Tohoku Electric's Onagawa, Tokyo Electric's Fukushima Daini and Kashiwazaki-Kariwa and Japan Atomic Power's Tokai stations, with the state of each unit (operating, shut down, under construction, decommissioning) and, for decommissioning units, the date work began. Coverage is Japan. Access: web page in Japanese, free; no licence is stated. Caveats: a status snapshot, not a time series. It suits capacity and outage planning studies for the Japanese power system, and no directly related records are catalogued yet.
